scope: Specified before any new slope-sweep evaluations
formulation: Existing deterministic shrinking-horizon MIQP with the band indicator replaced by slope times positive threshold excess; all physical direction binaries and common terminal penalty retained.
deployment: After the standard feasible-action recovery, an action with a positive grid overshoot no greater than 1e-5 kW is snapped to a verified feasible non-exceeding threshold candidate when available. Hard billing remains exact, with no billing tolerance. This gives the surrogate a threshold-aware deployment treatment and avoids evaluating numerical overshoots as deliberate fee decisions.
recording: Retain raw action, final action and additional threshold-polish displacement for every solve. No objective, data, training weights or tariff parameters are changed.
